audience: developers who track errors, releases and performance in Raygun

useCases.title: Review errors after the latest deployment
useCases.text: Get the latest deployment of an application. Then list its error groups with their status and last occurrence.

useCases.title: Read one error with its stack trace
useCases.text: Get an error group, then read its latest occurrence with the stack trace and breadcrumbs.

useCases.title: Find slow API traces
useCases.text: Search the APM traces in a time window of up to 30 days, by duration or HTTP status. Open one trace to read its calls.

useCases.title: Check the error trend over time
useCases.text: List the error groups to get their ids. Then count the error occurrences over time for some of them.

useCases.title: Resolve an error group after a fix
useCases.text: Mark an error group as resolved, or set it back to active. Both steps are reversible.

useCases.title: Record a deployment for a release
useCases.text: List the deployments of an application, then create a deployment record for the new release.
